name: ImputeByModeNode
label: Impute by Mode
description: Replaces missing (null) values in one or more columns with the most frequently occurring value of each column. Computed per optional group columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the columns to impute.

fields.name: ColumnsToImpute
fields.label: Columns To Impute
fields.description: Comma-separated column names whose null values are replaced with the mode.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to compute the mode within. Leave empty to use the whole table.

fields.name: ImputedDataTable
fields.label: Imputed Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with imputed values.
